categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in smart transportation and smart governance sectors. Its key business segments include large-scale application of Beidou satellite navigation technology, Beidou free-flow tolling systems, vehicle-road-cloud integration, and smart government services. It also develops AI, data asset value conversion, domestic substitution and trusted computing, and edge computing capabilities. The company offers terminal installation services, platform product services, insurance revenue sharing, and integrated hardware-software services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include Beidou high-precision satellite navigation, AI large models and agents, big data analytics, blockchain, IoT, 5G communication, RTK/RTD positioning, inertial navigation systems (INS), and multi-modal AI. The company develops intelligent vehicle-mounted terminals integrating Beidou chips and AI imaging chips, AI-driven risk control models (ASLM), vehicle-road-cloud collaborative systems (C-V2X), and smart infrastructure monitoring using InSAR, drones, and AI. It also provides AI-powered smart archives and digital governance platforms with multi-modal data processing and expert mixture models (MoE).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies (e.g., municipal archives, judicial departments), transportation and logistics companies, insurance firms, and enterprises in smart city and smart agriculture sectors. The company serves markets in smart transportation management, digital government, food safety traceability, judicial information systems, and supply chain digitalization. Major contracts include a significant order from China Automotive Technology and Research Center for intelligent networked vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant business in East China (notably Shanghai and Zhejiang), North China (including Beijing), South China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It has subsidiaries in Zhejiang, Hainan, Beijing, Shanghai, and other provinces. The company supports national-level projects and participates in pilot programs across major Chinese cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It develops and deploys satellite navigation terminals, software platforms, and integrated solutions for smart transportation and governance. It collaborates with upstream chip suppliers (e.g., Huada Beidou) for high-precision positioning chips and provides end-to-end services including data collection, platform operation, and value-added services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening AI empowerment, expanding Beidou large-scale applications, and accelerating intelligent transformation. The company focuses on R&D in AI large models, AI agents, multi-modal fusion algorithms, and edge computing. It aims to enhance intelligent vehicle terminals, risk control systems, vehicle-road-cloud integration, and smart infrastructure monitoring. The company also invests in smart archives, digital governance, and food safety traceability platforms, emphasizing data asset capitalization and industry digitalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through system integration projects, technology support and services, application software development and sales, and terminal service fees. The company employs subscription and project-based billing for platform services, licensing fees for technology modules, and data monetization through insurance revenue sharing and data services. It also earns service fees from Beidou free-flow tolling systems and smart governance solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading provider in the smart transportation and smart governance sectors in China, leveraging its strong Beidou satellite navigation technology and AI capabilities. It competes with other technology firms in AI, IoT, and digital government solutions, maintaining a competitive edge through proprietary technologies like ASLM risk control and integrated vehicle-road-cloud platforms. Its strategic partnerships and government-backed projects reinforce its market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 268.7 million, a 9.02% increase from 2023. Despite ongoing net losses, the net loss attributable to shareholders narrowed by 36.35%. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.19 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 459.5 million. The company is in a growth phase, expanding terminal deployments and securing large-scale contracts, with a focus on transitioning from project-based to terminal-driven revenue growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its dual-core advantage of 'Beidou+AI' technology, offering highly precise satellite positioning combined with advanced AI analytics and decision-making capabilities. Its products provide high-accuracy, real-time vehicle tracking, intelligent risk control, and integrated smart city solutions. Proprietary technologies like ASLM risk control model and AI-powered smart archives differentiate it by enhancing safety, efficiency, and data-driven governance. The company’s comprehensive ecosystem from terminal hardware to cloud platforms and data services creates a unique competitive edge.
